_comment: AI eval cases for answer_ask. The model gets the published Notices of notices.json (by id) and the question. expect_covered=false cases must come back not covered after app.domain.grounding.ground(); a covered case must cite expect_sources.

cases._why: no Notice states a collection day; a guessed weekday is the failure
